purpose: Canonical, traceable external-evidence registry for the physically-recognized radionuclide universe. Preserves BOTH the raw source value and the normalized value used by canonical repository authorities. Inclusion here NEVER by itself changes a repository canonical fact; a matching canonical propagation + test lock is required (Section 33A/M.1). Content summarized/paraphrased from cited sources for licensing compliance.

normalization_notes.half_life_minutes: raw half-life values converted to minutes: hours*60, days*1440. Preserves the source's own stated unit in raw_value/raw_unit.
normalization_notes.clinical_modality: PET | SPECT | THERAPY | GENERATOR_PARENT. A radionuclide may carry more than one role across records; the canonical modality authority admits only diagnostic-imaging roles (PET/SPECT) to scanner demand.
normalization_notes.content_compliance: Every source snippet was rephrased for compliance with licensing restrictions; no more than a short factual value (half-life number, modality, indication) is carried, always with an inline source reference.
